english.title: Manufacturer fail to keep / transfer / provide required info for cat F1/F2/F3 firework placed on market post 16/10/16
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the manufacturer of a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_
(C)_[F3]_

firework and placed it on the market after 16th October 2016 and failed

(D)_[to keep a record of the required information, as defined in regulation 20(4) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015, for the firework for a period of at least 10 years beginning on the day on which it was placed on the market, that date being **(..SPECIFY DATE ARTICLE PLACED ON THE MARKET..)]_
(E)_[to transfer the record of the required information, as defined in regulation 20(4) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015, for the firework to the Secretary of State upon ceasing to trade]_
(F)_[upon a reasoned request, to provide an enforcing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY ENFORCING AUTHORITY..), with the required information, as defined in regulation 20(4) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(2), 62(1)(i) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location

after 16/10/16
failed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) does not apply (i.e. not a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is triable either way - see offence document H12282 (CJS code PA15045)
(ii) If it is an importer who has placed the pyrotechnic article on the market offence document H12308 (CJS code PA15071) should be used
